biotools.summary: Simpipe is a pipeline for systematically evaluating and simulating single-cell and spatially resolved transcriptomics data. It provides a standard pipeline and an online tool (Simsite) to facilitate data simulation and benchmarking, offering practical guidelines for method selection and use.
